yellow_journalism_note.era: 1895-1925: Pulitzer vs Hearst, sensational headlines, comic strips (Yellow Kid), woodcut illustrations
yellow_journalism_note.why_it_fits: yellow journalism was the FIRST mass media immune system. it classified the world into threats and stories. it had weather (the news), traffic (circulation), flows (information), and whale-falls (scandals that died). the thymus IS a news desk. the news desk IS a thymus.
yellow_journalism_note.the_comics: the Funny Pages were where the serious truth hid in humor. the Sunday Funnies showed what the front page couldn't say.
yellow_journalism_note.our_version: three papers, three perspectives, one organism. the era of comics and funny and yellow journalism — because the immune system IS the newspaper.
